TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 7, 30th September, 2025

Construction of Access Arterial Road S1 from Ring 2 to FCT Fire Station in Kaura District

Motorists plying Kado-Galadima, Lokogoma, Sun City and other locations within these axis are hereby informed of movement of dignitaries to the venue of the event near the FCT Fire Service station in Kaura.

Traffic along these routes will be slightly affected but traffic control personnel and Security agents will be on ground to ensure seamless movement and conduct of all road users.

Your cooperation again is highly solicited.

— Head Traffic DRTS.
